name: pyhouse
description: The whole pyhouse catalogue in one install: depends on pyhouse-universal, pyhouse-hex, pyhouse-flat, pyhouse-git and pyhouse-delivery, which Claude Code installs with it, and ships /pyhouse:setup, which sets a repository up for them in one run — the Python skill table and the branching section in its CLAUDE.md, the agent's authorship line turned off, and the commit-msg hook — by running each plugin's own commands in turn. Holds no skill and states no rule of its own.
